title: Bounded seasonal security, ordinary patrol, market construction, monthly money and full named-office payroll v1
description: Closed structural contract for every public DTO and all success/failure/trace/save/result forms. Root anyOf allows overlapping result families; correlated DTOs use oneOf. The complete fixed source artifact is represented by an exact const. Schema is descriptive data only; no validation, compilation, scenario execution or native verification is claimed.
$comment: All object shapes, including slot tuple positions and contains predicates, are closed and require all declared keys. JSON Schema cannot establish descriptor safety, reject proxies/getters/prototype hazards, distinguish parsed -0 from +0, detect decoded duplicate keys lost by a parser, freeze detached outputs, calculate canonical digests, verify true UTF-8/node/depth budgets, enforce first-error or atomic commit semantics, prove cross-object identity/order/arithmetic, execute kernels/phases, or perform full history reconstruction. Those obligations belong to the owner implementation. Source literal manifests are public provenance, not runtime authority; original false evidence is never upgraded. All public aliases are DeepReadonly in TypeScript; schema aliases reference their complete DTO. Patrol and construction progression share merit; unselected fields cannot change. Patrol sourceEvidence is a fixed source projection, never claimed as phase output. Full replay, 25 history and 32 complete expected outcomes are retained. This independent profile adds a complete conditional future-window RNG tape (0..4 supplied draws), fixed governor and administrative reform, quarterly security after income and before salary, and full cursor/draw receipts. Owner recomputation enforces all cross-field equality, chronological index, matching tape/purpose, full-window coverage and atomic rollback. Unused structurally valid tape suffix is allowed. Seasonal policy remains provisional; native RNG is not verified.

JobId.description: The owner also requires exactly job: plus the accepted start envelope id.

InitialClock.description: The owner verifies turn + advanceLimit <= MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and the complete date window.

Scenario.description: Exactly 27 required keys. Non-null governorOfficerId names one of the complete fixed resident officers. The owner enumerates all future dates in the 1..12-advance window and verifies conditional tape coverage without consuming it. On each entered Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct day 1, reform first requires bound100, skips below50, otherwise requires bound3; no reform requires only bound3. Every supplied suffix row must still be structurally valid; an unused suffix is allowed.

RateReceipt.description: The owner calls the delivered construction development leaf and original rate kernel and compares every result field. Arithmetic and selected-branch equality are not established by this schema.

Ledger.description: gold is the sole mutable gold balance; goldCapacity equals genesis capacity. Accepted Patrol may raise security and writes patrolUsedTurn; quarterly Advance may lower security after current income and before full salary. Start and other Advance dates preserve security; only Patrol changes the marker. The owner checks the complete chronological security, gold and RNG history, all references, fixed row order, membership and two-way reservations.

Work.description: Construction work is a scheduler quantity, not combat HP, durability damage, or repair state.

Job.description: The owner checks dueTurn/date from ceil(375/rate), selected-id/politics alignment, active elapsed work and remaining count, completedTurn=dueTurn, complete original snapshot/fees/kernel evidence, and the permanent completed-job history.

Reserve.description: Derived only: n=advanceLimit-advancedCount; H=floor((dayOffset+n)/3); W is the full fixed catalog payroll; required=H*W; spendableGold=gold-required. No prepaid amount or separate wallet. The owner verifies these equalities and gold>=required.

MoneyResult.description: Every slot is explicit and index equals its tuple position. The owner compares original kernel input/result/evidence and all arithmetic to the full recomputed transition; this schema does not establish kernel execution or native evidence.

Salary.description: Both branches retain every fixed resident, including unavailable, acted and reserved officers, in ascending code-unit id order. The owner checks completeness, unique offices, item/id alignment, sum, paid=sum when due, and the available balance after income clipping.

MonthlyReceipt.description: Settled means exactly income then full salary, with complete 30-slot input/result and payroll. Completion-before-income is a provisional owner order. The owner verifies date/city/slot correspondence and the full gold before/after chain; income and salary may not be replaced by a net write.

Envelope.description: expectedRevision retains the entire safe nonnegative integer domain. The owner performs accepted-id deduplication before stale revision or command-domain checks.

State.description: The owner reconstructs from the complete genesis and every accepted envelope, compares every receipt and the whole final state, checks every reachable prefix, rejects repeated accepted ids, and verifies all digests. Schema conformance alone does not establish reachability or trust.

Proposal.description: The owner checks shortfall=required-available>0. Reserve uses R and the relevant gold balance; salary uses W and the exact phase balance.

Failure.description: Twelve required keys. Only salary shortfalls carry Proposal, only money-kernel-rejected carries kernelReason, and only patrol-phase-rejected carries PatrolReason with all entity context null. Rebuild normalization clears irrelevant specialized reasons; history indices 0..24, trace indices 0..31, ordinary API index null.

serialized.description: Complete canonical SaveEnvelope text, never a digest or history summary. contentSchema is an annotation, not a guarantee of strict parsing or recomputation. The owner enforces actual UTF-8 bytes, duplicate decoded keys, safe integer/-0 rejection, all budgets, full fold, and the complete twice-escaped result budget.

Trace.description: Every one of up to 32 attempts may contain the complete expected success/duplicate receipt or Failure. expectedFinalState, when nonnull, contains the entire genesis/current/history. Expected values do not control execution. The owner compares full outcomes and final state and accounts for the whole trace input independently of the replay output.

source.acquisition: Copied the fixed audit snapshot locally, checked both encodings and pinned Git blob; the audit retained connector-decoded text and reversibly reconstructed GBK. No new download or independent executable extraction.

inputProvenance.precondition: City pointer validation at 0049E59D passed and virtual40 owner result at 0049E5B1 is 0..46; helpers return normally preserving the nonvolatile-register and stack contract. These conditions are requirements, not callee certifications.
inputProvenance.slots: Exactly 30 observations; null is a resolved zero result of pointer validator 0047A630 at 0049E5E7, never missing data
inputProvenance.facilityTypeWord: U32 [facility+8] at 0049E5F7; dispatch uses (word-31) modulo 2^32 and an unsigned comparison to 20
inputProvenance.constructionWord: U32 [facility+0x14] at the selected branch; every nonzero bit pattern means complete
inputProvenance.resolvedTypeRows: One stable row per effective type; lookup 00490B90 and validator 0047A630 resolved externally; valid moneyYieldWord is U16 [row+0xC0] at 0049E63D
inputProvenance.adjacentMint: Boolean of zero/nonzero return from 0049E500 at 0049E660 for this facility coordinate and type 0x26, consumed only after valid effective type 31/50/51; geometry and helper filters are not reconstructed
inputProvenance.difficultyWord: U32 [07201978] at 0049E6B1; exactly 0 and 2 are special, all other word patterns use 100 percent
inputProvenance.cityPlayerPredicate: Boolean of city virtual48 return at 0049E6C9, consumed only for difficultyWord equal to 2
inputProvenance.securityByte: Late U8 [city+0x85] read at 0049E6FE, lower clamp 50 and no upper clamp 100

arithmetic.rawMoney: baseMoneyWord + sum(30 locally calculated slot contributions)
arithmetic.mintContribution: floor(3*moneyYieldWord/2) only for effective type 31/50/51 with adjacentMint true
arithmetic.difficultyPercent: 0 -> 125; 2 with player true -> 75; 2 with player false -> 125; every other U32 -> 100
operationOrder: difficultyProduct = scaledRaw*difficultyPercent only for difficultyWord 0 or 2; otherwise null
difficultyAdjusted = difficultyProduct/100 truncated toward zero if present; otherwise scaledRaw
arithmetic.safeDomain: Every actual scaledRaw, difficultyProduct (when present) and securityProduct must be <= 2147483647; inputs and products are nonnegative. Do not test a nonexistent rawMoney*100*100 product on ordinary difficulty.
arithmetic.overflowBehavior: unsupported-arithmetic-domain, no wrap, no saturation and no unbounded substitute result
originalMnemonicTypos: c1 fa 05 decodes SAR EDX,5, not the listed SAR DL,5
83 fe ff decodes CMP ESI,-1, not a comparison to 255

runtimeContract.conditionalObservationValidation: The schema encodes referenced-row presence, difficulty predicate and cross-row adjacentMint consumption. The runtime additionally validates arithmetic support and JavaScript data descriptors/prototypes without invoking accessors.
runtimeContract.numericSemantics: Finite integral JSON numbers in the stated widths; booleans and strings are not numbers; no coercion or truncation; negative zero normalizes to zero.
runtimeContract.typeScriptOutput: Deeply frozen scalar receipts; no mutable input references
runtimeContract.pythonOutput: Fresh plain JSON dictionaries/lists and scalar integers; no mutable input references, but Python receipts are not frozen
runtimeContract.rejectionOrder: top closed fields, profile, numeric widths, difficulty predicate, complete type-row structure, dense 30-slot array, each slot and its consumed observations in index order, arithmetic domain

RngCurrent.description: Full cumulative consumed prefix, cursor equals length. The owner requires indices 0..cursor-1, exact supplied tape values, chronological purpose order and full replay equality.

SeasonalSecurityReceipt.description: The owner verifies fixed governor/charm, before and after against the real ledger, requestedLoss=min(5,floor(max(1,90-charm)/10)+lossRoll), actualLoss=min(before,requestedLoss), and unchanged security for not-due/skip.

SeasonalSecurityDetail.description: Not-due consumes0; reform skip consumes1 bound100; no reform applied consumes1 bound3; failed reform applied consumes2 in bound100,bound3 order. The owner enforces rngAfter=rngBefore+drawsConsumed.length, chronological indices, exact roll equality and the identical slice in the common receipt. Applied returns a write even for zero requested or actual loss; no negative zero is allowed.
